{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows with sentinel values (ages > 120 or < 0)
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_age'] >= 0) & (sales_df['customer_age'] <= 120)]

# Compute the mean age of customers
mean_age = filtered_df['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age"}
